dz: 主教座堂由努西阿伊宁迁至克罗伊宁(地处图尔库目前的中心附近),得到教宗格雷戈里九世的允许. 该日期开始被认为是图尔库的创立.
de: The episcopal seat is moved from Nousiainen to Koroinen (located near the current centre of Turku) by the permission of Pope Gregory IX. The date is starting to be considered as the founding of Turku.

te: Frederick II, Holy Roman Emperor, signs a ten-year truce with al-Kamil, regaining Jerusalem, Nazareth, and Bethlehem wi…
dz: 第六次十字军东征:弗雷德里克二世,神圣罗马皇帝,与al-Kamil签订十年停战协议,在既没有军事交战也没有教宗支持的情况下收复了耶路撒冷,拿撒勒和伯利恒.
de: The Sixth Crusade: Frederick II, Holy Roman Emperor, signs a ten-year truce with al-Kamil, regaining Jerusalem, Nazareth, and Bethlehem with neither military engagements nor support from the papacy.

t: 弗雷德里克二世是神圣罗马皇帝,在第六次十字军东征中宣布自己为耶路撒冷国王.
te: Frederick II, Holy Roman Emperor, declares himself King of Jerusalem in the Sixth Crusade.
dz: 弗雷德里克二世是神圣罗马皇帝,在第六次十字军东征中宣布自己为耶路撒冷国王.
de: Frederick II, Holy Roman Emperor, declares himself King of Jerusalem in the Sixth Crusade.

dz: 波多比之战:阿拉贡的詹姆斯一世所指挥的阿拉贡军队在马略卡州圣庞萨下岸,目的是征服该岛.
de: Battle of Portopí: The Aragonese army under the command of James I of Aragon disembarks at Santa Ponça, Mallorca, with the purpose of conquering the island.

dz: 窝阔台汗在蒙古肯特省科多阿拉尔被宣布为蒙古帝国可汗。
de: Ögedei Khan is proclaimed Khagan of the Mongol Empire in Kodoe Aral, Khentii: Mongolia.

te: James I the Conqueror, King of Aragon, enters Medina Mayurqa (now known as Palma de Mallorca, Spain), thus consummating…
dz: 征服者,阿拉贡国王詹姆斯一世入驻麦地那·马尤尔卡(现为西班牙帕尔马·德·马略卡),从而完成了基督教对马略卡岛的重新征服.
de: James I the Conqueror, King of Aragon, enters Medina Mayurqa (now known as Palma de Mallorca, Spain), thus consummating the Christian reconquest of the island of Mallorca.
